test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following pie chart shows the percentage distribution of 250 students at Delhi University, who are from different parts of the world, speaking different languages. Based on the pie chart answer the question given below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06730c82171373832c37608f6dc5a9fac30c4b9a14342b4a968a6fdf65e4ea71.png] 

How many students speak Spanish as one of their languages?
solution:
**Given:**

The following pie chart shows the percentage distribution of 250 students at Delhi University, who are from different parts of the world, and speaking different languages. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06730c82171373832c37608f6dc5a9fac30c4b9a14342b4a968a6fdf65e4ea71.png] 

**Calculation:**

Total number of students speaking English and Spanish is 30% of 250 

= 0.30 × 250

= 75

Total number of students speaking Spanish only 

= 12% of 250

= 0.12 × 250

= 30

So, Total number of students who speaks Spanish as one of their languages

= 75 + 30

= 105

**Thus, 105 students speak Spanish as one of the languages.**

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1)**.
